phases.note: MT is the opening main tank; OT is the off tank. For the mitigated Powder Mark, use the marked cooldowns late. The source footnote claiming Powder Mark 2 mitigation covers Burnished Glory 2 conflicts with the log order. Healers should mitigate the opening tank for Burn Mark 2 on the first-Powder invuln plan.
Personal mit is free for autos this phase.
